blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Find the point(s) of intersection of the following functions graphically: \(f(x) = 2x + 5\), \(g(x) = -x + 5\).
blocks.explanation:
Do seedhi lines di gayi hain. Do graphs wahan milte hain jahan dono ka x bhi same ho aur y bhi same ho, yani jahan \(f(x) = g(x)\).
Humein wohi mushtarka (common) point find karna hai.
Plan: dono lines ke liye aik hi x-values wali table banayenge, dekhenge kis column mein dono ke jawab barabar hain, dono lines aik hi axes par kheenchenge, crossing parhenge, aur aakhir mein algebra se tasdeeq karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 2x + 5\) aur \(g(x) = -x + 5\), do linear functions.
Humein find karna hai: woh point jahan dono graphs aik doosre ko kaat-te hain.
Tareeqa: dono functions ki aik hi x-values par table banayenge, dono lines kheenchenge aur mushtarka point parhenge. Us point par \(f(x) = g(x)\) hota hai, is liye algebra se tasdeeq bhi ho sakti hai.

Dono functions ki aik table banayein
\[x:\ -2,\ -1,\ 0,\ 1,\ 2\]
\[f(x):\ 1,\ 3,\ 5,\ 7,\ 9\]
\[g(x):\ 7,\ 6,\ 5,\ 4,\ 3\]
Kyun: jab dono ke liye x-values aik jaisi hon to har column mein seedha muqabla ho jata hai. Dekhiye, \(x = 0\) wale column mein dono outputs barabar hain; yahi hamara milne ka point hai. Yahan aik khaas baat: dono ka constant term 5 hai, is liye dono y-axis par \((0, 5)\) se guzarti hain.

Dono lines aik hi axes par kheenchein
\(f\): rising line (slope 2) through \((0, 5)\) and \((-\tfrac{5}{2}, 0)\).
\(g\): falling line (slope \(-1\)) through \((0, 5)\) and \((5, 0)\).
Dono lines \((0,\ 5)\) par kaat-ti hain.
Kyun: aik line charhti hai (slope 2) aur doosri girti hai (slope \(-1\)). Dono ka y-intercept 5 hai, is liye dono y-axis par hi milti hain. Crossing point woh wahid point hai jo dono lines par aik saath parta hai. Do mukhtalif slopes wali lines sirf aik dafa milti hain.

Algebra se tasdeeq (\(f(x) = g(x)\) rakhein)
\[2x + 5 = -x + 5\]
\[3x = 0\]
\[x = 0\]
\[y = 2(0) + 5 = 5\]
Kyun: dono taraf \(x\) jama kiya aur 5 minus kiya, taa ke saare x-terms aik taraf aa jayein aur numbers doosri taraf.
Dhyan dein: \(x\) nikaal kar ruk na jayein; point ke liye \(y\) bhi chahiye, jo kisi bhi aik function mein \(x\) rakh kar milta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[f(0) = 2(0) + 5 = 5\]
\[g(0) = -0 + 5 = 5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: yeh point dono lines par hai, is liye dono equations ko poora karna chahiye. Dono mein same \(y\) aa gaya, to jawab pakka hai.

answer_figure.alt: Rising line f(x) = 2x + 5 and falling line g(x) = -x + 5 crossing at (0, 5) on the y-axis.
answer_figure.caption: Question 2 (i): both lines and their meeting point (original drawing)

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Find the point(s) of intersection of the following functions graphically: \(f(x) = 3x - 2\), \(g(x) = 10 - x\).
blocks.explanation:
Do seedhi lines di gayi hain. Do graphs wahan milte hain jahan dono ka x bhi same ho aur y bhi same ho, yani jahan \(f(x) = g(x)\).
Humein wohi mushtarka (common) point find karna hai.
Plan: dono lines ke liye aik hi x-values wali table banayenge, dekhenge kis column mein dono ke jawab barabar hain, dono lines aik hi axes par kheenchenge, crossing parhenge, aur aakhir mein algebra se tasdeeq karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 3x - 2\) aur \(g(x) = 10 - x\), do linear functions.
Humein find karna hai: woh point jahan dono graphs aik doosre ko kaat-te hain.
Tareeqa: dono functions ki aik hi x-values par table banayenge, dono lines kheenchenge aur mushtarka point parhenge. Us point par \(f(x) = g(x)\) hota hai, is liye algebra se tasdeeq bhi ho sakti hai.

Dono functions ki aik table banayein
\[x:\ 1,\ 2,\ 3,\ 4\]
\[f(x):\ 1,\ 4,\ 7,\ 10\]
\[g(x):\ 9,\ 8,\ 7,\ 6\]
Kyun: jab dono ke liye x-values aik jaisi hon to har column mein seedha muqabla ho jata hai. Dekhiye, \(x = 3\) wale column mein dono outputs barabar hain; yahi hamara milne ka point hai. Table mein dekhiye: \(f\) har qadam par 3 barhta hai aur \(g\) 1 ghatta hai, is liye farq jaldi khatam ho jata hai.

Dono lines aik hi axes par kheenchein
\(f\): rising line (slope 3) through \((0, -2)\) and \((\tfrac{2}{3}, 0)\).
\(g\): falling line (slope \(-1\)) through \((0, 10)\) and \((10, 0)\).
Dono lines \((3,\ 7)\) par kaat-ti hain.
Kyun: \(f\) tez charhti hai aur \(g\) aahista girti hai, is liye yeh y-axis ke right mein sirf aik dafa milti hain. Crossing point woh wahid point hai jo dono lines par aik saath parta hai. Do mukhtalif slopes wali lines sirf aik dafa milti hain.

Algebra se tasdeeq (\(f(x) = g(x)\) rakhein)
\[3x - 2 = 10 - x\]
\[3x + x = 10 + 2\]
\[4x = 12\]
\[x = 3\]
\[y = 3(3) - 2 = 7\]
Kyun: \(-x\) ko left par aur \(-2\) ko right par le gaye; side badalne par sign badal jata hai. Is se like terms ikatthe ho gaye.
Dhyan dein: \(x\) nikaal kar ruk na jayein; point ke liye \(y\) bhi chahiye, jo kisi bhi aik function mein \(x\) rakh kar milta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[f(3) = 9 - 2 = 7\]
\[g(3) = 10 - 3 = 7 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: yeh point dono lines par hai, is liye dono equations ko poora karna chahiye. Dono mein same \(y\) aa gaya, to jawab pakka hai.

answer_figure.alt: Rising line f(x) = 3x - 2 and falling line g(x) = 10 - x crossing at (3, 7).
answer_figure.caption: Question 2 (ii): both lines and their meeting point (original drawing)

blocks.prompt: 2 (iii) Find the point(s) of intersection of the following functions graphically: \(f(x) = 2x - 4\), \(g(x) = 3x - 1\).
blocks.explanation:
Do seedhi lines di gayi hain. Do graphs wahan milte hain jahan dono ka x bhi same ho aur y bhi same ho, yani jahan \(f(x) = g(x)\).
Humein wohi mushtarka (common) point find karna hai.
Plan: dono lines ke liye aik hi x-values wali table banayenge, dekhenge kis column mein dono ke jawab barabar hain, dono lines aik hi axes par kheenchenge, crossing parhenge, aur aakhir mein algebra se tasdeeq karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 2x - 4\) aur \(g(x) = 3x - 1\), do linear functions.
Humein find karna hai: woh point jahan dono graphs aik doosre ko kaat-te hain.
Tareeqa: dono functions ki aik hi x-values par table banayenge, dono lines kheenchenge aur mushtarka point parhenge. Us point par \(f(x) = g(x)\) hota hai, is liye algebra se tasdeeq bhi ho sakti hai.

Dono functions ki aik table banayein
\[x:\ -4,\ -3,\ -2,\ -1,\ 0\]
\[f(x):\ -12,\ -10,\ -8,\ -6,\ -4\]
\[g(x):\ -13,\ -10,\ -7,\ -4,\ -1\]
Kyun: jab dono ke liye x-values aik jaisi hon to har column mein seedha muqabla ho jata hai. Dekhiye, \(x = -3\) wale column mein dono outputs barabar hain; yahi hamara milne ka point hai. Agar aap sirf positive x-values lete to yeh point table mein nazar hi na aata; is liye negative values bhi try karni chahiye.

Dono lines aik hi axes par kheenchein
\(f\): rising line (slope 2) through \((0, -4)\) and \((2, 0)\).
\(g\): steeper rising line (slope 3) through \((0, -1)\) and \((\tfrac{1}{3}, 0)\).
Dono lines \((-3,\ -10)\) par kaat-ti hain.
Kyun: dono lines charhti hain lekin slopes mukhtalif hain (2 aur 3), is liye parallel nahin aur sirf aik dafa milti hain. Milne ka point teesre quadrant mein kaafi neeche hai, is liye y-axis ko kam az kam \(-10\) tak banana zaroori hai. Crossing point woh wahid point hai jo dono lines par aik saath parta hai. Do mukhtalif slopes wali lines sirf aik dafa milti hain.

Algebra se tasdeeq (\(f(x) = g(x)\) rakhein)
\[2x - 4 = 3x - 1\]
\[-4 + 1 = 3x - 2x\]
\[x = -3\]
\[y = 2(-3) - 4 = -10\]
Kyun: dono taraf se \(2x\) minus kiya aur 1 jama kiya, to sirf \(x\) bacha: \(x = -3\).
Dhyan dein: \(x\) nikaal kar ruk na jayein; point ke liye \(y\) bhi chahiye, jo kisi bhi aik function mein \(x\) rakh kar milta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[f(-3) = -6 - 4 = -10\]
\[g(-3) = -9 - 1 = -10 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: yeh point dono lines par hai, is liye dono equations ko poora karna chahiye. Dono mein same \(y\) aa gaya, to jawab pakka hai.

answer_figure.alt: Two rising lines f(x) = 2x - 4 and g(x) = 3x - 1 crossing at (-3, -10) in the third quadrant.
answer_figure.caption: Question 2 (iii): both lines and their meeting point (original drawing)

blocks.prompt: 2 (iv) Find the point(s) of intersection of the following functions graphically: \(f(x) = -3x - 4\), \(g(x) = \dfrac{1}{2}x + 3\).
blocks.explanation:
Do seedhi lines di gayi hain. Do graphs wahan milte hain jahan dono ka x bhi same ho aur y bhi same ho, yani jahan \(f(x) = g(x)\).
Humein wohi mushtarka (common) point find karna hai.
Plan: dono lines ke liye aik hi x-values wali table banayenge, dekhenge kis column mein dono ke jawab barabar hain, dono lines aik hi axes par kheenchenge, crossing parhenge, aur aakhir mein algebra se tasdeeq karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = -3x - 4\) aur \(g(x) = \dfrac{1}{2}x + 3\), do linear functions.
Humein find karna hai: woh point jahan dono graphs aik doosre ko kaat-te hain.
Tareeqa: dono functions ki aik hi x-values par table banayenge, dono lines kheenchenge aur mushtarka point parhenge. Us point par \(f(x) = g(x)\) hota hai, is liye algebra se tasdeeq bhi ho sakti hai.

Dono functions ki aik table banayein
\[x:\ -4,\ -2,\ 0,\ 2\]
\[f(x):\ 8,\ 2,\ -4,\ -10\]
\[g(x):\ 1,\ 2,\ 3,\ 4\]
Kyun: jab dono ke liye x-values aik jaisi hon to har column mein seedha muqabla ho jata hai. Dekhiye, \(x = -2\) wale column mein dono outputs barabar hain; yahi hamara milne ka point hai. \(g\) mein \(\tfrac{1}{2}x\) hai, is liye hum ne sirf even x-values li hain; is se table mein fractions nahin aate.

Dono lines aik hi axes par kheenchein
\(f\): falling line (slope \(-3\)) through \((0, -4)\) and \((-\tfrac{4}{3}, 0)\).
\(g\): gently rising line (slope \(\tfrac{1}{2}\)) through \((0, 3)\) and \((-6, 0)\).
Dono lines \((-2,\ 2)\) par kaat-ti hain.
Kyun: aik line tez girti hai aur doosri aahista charhti hai; dono doosre quadrant mein milti hain. Even x-values is liye li hain ke \(\tfrac{1}{2}x\) poora number aaye. Crossing point woh wahid point hai jo dono lines par aik saath parta hai. Do mukhtalif slopes wali lines sirf aik dafa milti hain.

Algebra se tasdeeq (\(f(x) = g(x)\) rakhein)
\[-3x - 4 = \dfrac{1}{2}x + 3\]
\[-6x - 8 = x + 6\]
\[-7x = 14\]
\[x = -2\]
\[y = -3(-2) - 4 = 2\]
Kyun: har term ko 2 se multiply kiya taa ke fraction \(\tfrac{1}{2}\) khatam ho jaye; phir like terms ikatthe kiye. Har term ko multiply karna zaroori hai, sirf fraction wale ko nahin.
Dhyan dein: \(x\) nikaal kar ruk na jayein; point ke liye \(y\) bhi chahiye, jo kisi bhi aik function mein \(x\) rakh kar milta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[f(-2) = 6 - 4 = 2\]
\[g(-2) = -1 + 3 = 2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: yeh point dono lines par hai, is liye dono equations ko poora karna chahiye. Dono mein same \(y\) aa gaya, to jawab pakka hai.

answer_figure.alt: Falling line f(x) = -3x - 4 and gently rising line g(x) = (1/2)x + 3 crossing at (-2, 2) in the second quadrant.
answer_figure.caption: Question 2 (iv): both lines and their meeting point (original drawing)

blocks.prompt: 2 (v) Find the point(s) of intersection of the following functions graphically: \(f(x) = x - 1\), \(g(x) = x^2 - 4x + 3\).
blocks.explanation:
Is dafa aik line aur aik parabola (U-shape curve) hai. Aisi do graphs do points par mil sakti hain, aik point par, ya bilkul nahin. Milne ke points wahan hain jahan \(f(x) = g(x)\).
Humein saare milne ke points find karne hain, sirf aik nahin.
Plan: pehle parabola ka vertex (sab se neecha point) aur intercepts nikaalenge, phir vertex ke aas paas dono graphs ki table, phir dono aik hi axes par, crossings parh kar quadratic equation se tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: line \(f(x) = x - 1\) aur parabola \(g(x) = x^2 - 4x + 3\).
Humein find karna hai: woh saare points jahan dono graphs milte hain.
Tareeqa: parabola ko us ke vertex aur intercepts se samjhenge, dono functions ki table banayenge, aik saath plot kar ke crossings parhenge, aur phir \(f(x) = g(x)\) solve kar ke tasdeeq karenge.

Parabola ko samjhein
\[a = 1,\ b = -4,\ c = 3\]
\[x = -\dfrac{b}{2a} = \dfrac{4}{2} = 2\]
\[g(2) = 4 - 8 + 3 = -1\]
Vertex \((2, -1)\); parabola upar ki taraf khulta hai.
Kyun: vertex parabola ka mor (turning point) hai; table ki x-values isi ke dono taraf lete hain taa ke curve ki shakal poori nazar aaye. \(a > 0\) ka matlab hai parabola upar ki taraf khulta hai (U-shape), is liye vertex sab se neecha point hai.
Dhyan dein: vertex ka formula \(x = -\dfrac{b}{2a}\) hai; minus sign bhoolna aam ghalti hai.

Parabola ke intercepts nikaalein
y-intercept: \(g(0) = 3\), so \((0, 3)\).
\[x^2 - 4x + 3 = 0\]
\[(x - 1)(x - 3) = 0\]
x-intercepts: \((1, 0)\) and \((3, 0)\).
Kyun: intercepts bilkul pakke points hote hain jo graph par aasaani se lagte hain; in se curve sahi jagah se guzarti hai. x-intercepts ke liye \(g(x) = 0\) ko factorize kiya.

Dono graphs ki aik table banayein
\[x:\ 0,\ 1,\ 2,\ 3,\ 4,\ 5\]
\[f(x):\ -1,\ 0,\ 1,\ 2,\ 3,\ 4\]
\[g(x):\ 3,\ 0,\ -1,\ 0,\ 3,\ 8\]
Kyun: jis column mein dono rows ki value same ho, wahan dono graphs aik hi point par hote hain. Dekhiye: \(x = 1\) aur \(x = 4\) par dono rows barabar hain. Aik crossing \((1, 0)\) x-axis par hi hai, kyunke line parabola ke aik x-intercept se guzarti hai.

Dono graphs aik hi axes par kheenchein
\(f\): rising line (slope 1) through \((0, -1)\) and \((1, 0)\).
\(g\): table ke points se guzarta hua U-shape curve, jo vertex wali khari line ke dono taraf aik jaisa (symmetric) hai. Parabola ko ruler se nahin, haath se smooth curve bana kar jorte hain.
Dono graphs \((1,\ 0) \text{ and } (4,\ 3)\) par kaat-te hain.
Kyun: seedhi line upar khulne wale parabola ko zyada se zyada do dafa kaat sakti hai. Yahan do crossings mili hain, is liye dono points likhna zaroori hai.
Dhyan dein: exam mein aksar students pehla point dekh kar ruk jate hain aur doosra point likhna bhool jate hain. Line aur parabola ke sawal mein hamesha poochiye: kya koi doosri crossing bhi hai? Quadratic equation ke do roots isi baat ka jawab dete hain.

Algebra se tasdeeq (\(f(x) = g(x)\) rakhein)
\[x - 1 = x^2 - 4x + 3\]
\[x^2 - 5x + 4 = 0\]
\[(x - 1)(x - 4) = 0\]
\[x = 1 \text{ or } x = 4\]
\[f(1) = 0,\quad f(4) = 3\]
Kyun: saare terms aik taraf le jaane se quadratic equation banti hai. Is ke roots milne ke points ke x-coordinates hain, aur un ko line mein rakhne se y-coordinates milte hain (line ki equation aasaan hai, is liye usi ko istemal kiya).

Tasdeeq
\[g(1) = 1 - 4 + 3 = 0 = f(1) \;\checkmark\]
\[g(4) = 16 - 16 + 3 = 3\]
\[f(4) = 4 - 1 = 3 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: har point dono equations ko poora kare tabhi woh dono graphs par hai. Dono points ne dono equations poori kar di hain.
blocks.final_answer: Dono graphs \((1, 0)\) aur \((4, 3)\) par milte hain.

answer_figure.alt: Line f(x) = x - 1 and upward parabola g(x) = x^2 - 4x + 3 with vertex (2, -1); they meet at (1, 0) and (4, 3).
answer_figure.caption: Question 2 (v): the line, the parabola and their meeting points (original drawing)

blocks.prompt: 2 (vi) Find the point(s) of intersection of the following functions graphically: \(f(x) = 3x + 4\), \(g(x) = x^2 + 2x - 8\).
blocks.explanation:
Is dafa aik line aur aik parabola (U-shape curve) hai. Aisi do graphs do points par mil sakti hain, aik point par, ya bilkul nahin. Milne ke points wahan hain jahan \(f(x) = g(x)\).
Humein saare milne ke points find karne hain, sirf aik nahin.

steps:
Diya gaya hai: line \(f(x) = 3x + 4\) aur parabola \(g(x) = x^2 + 2x - 8\).
Humein find karna hai: woh saare points jahan dono graphs milte hain.
Tareeqa: parabola ko us ke vertex aur intercepts se samjhenge, dono functions ki table banayenge, aik saath plot kar ke crossings parhenge, aur phir \(f(x) = g(x)\) solve kar ke tasdeeq karenge.

Parabola ko samjhein
\[a = 1,\ b = 2,\ c = -8\]
\[x = -\dfrac{b}{2a} = -\dfrac{2}{2} = -1\]
\[g(-1) = 1 - 2 - 8 = -9\]
Vertex \((-1, -9)\); parabola upar ki taraf khulta hai.
Kyun: vertex parabola ka mor (turning point) hai; table ki x-values isi ke dono taraf lete hain taa ke curve ki shakal poori nazar aaye. \(a > 0\) ka matlab hai parabola upar ki taraf khulta hai (U-shape), is liye vertex sab se neecha point hai.
Dhyan dein: vertex ka formula \(x = -\dfrac{b}{2a}\) hai; minus sign bhoolna aam ghalti hai.

Parabola ke intercepts nikaalein
y-intercept: \(g(0) = -8\), so \((0, -8)\).
\[x^2 + 2x - 8 = 0\]
\[(x + 4)(x - 2) = 0\]
x-intercepts: \((-4, 0)\) and \((2, 0)\).
Kyun: intercepts bilkul pakke points hote hain jo graph par aasaani se lagte hain; in se curve sahi jagah se guzarti hai. x-intercepts ke liye \(g(x) = 0\) ko factorize kiya.

Dono graphs ki aik table banayein
\[x:\ -4,\ -3,\ -2,\ -1,\ 0\]
\[f(x):\ -8,\ -5,\ -2,\ 1,\ 4\]
\[g(x):\ 0,\ -5,\ -8,\ -9,\ -8\]
Kyun: jis column mein dono rows ki value same ho, wahan dono graphs aik hi point par hote hain. \(x = -3\) par dono \(-5\) hain. Table ko \(x = 1, 2, 3, 4\) tak barhayein to \(f: 7, 10, 13, 16\) aur \(g: -5, 0, 7, 16\) aata hai, yani \(x = 4\) par dono 16 hain. Doosra point kaafi upar hai, is liye y-axis ko 20 tak banayein aur scale 1 square = 2 units rakhein; agar table jaldi rok dete to doosra point reh jata.

Dono graphs aik hi axes par kheenchein
\(f\): rising line (slope 3) through \((0, 4)\) and \((-\tfrac{4}{3}, 0)\).
\(g\): table ke points se guzarta hua U-shape curve, jo vertex wali khari line ke dono taraf aik jaisa (symmetric) hai. Parabola ko ruler se nahin, haath se smooth curve bana kar jorte hain.
Dono graphs \((-3,\ -5) \text{ and } (4,\ 16)\) par kaat-te hain.
Kyun: seedhi line upar khulne wale parabola ko zyada se zyada do dafa kaat sakti hai. Yahan do crossings mili hain, is liye dono points likhna zaroori hai.
Dhyan dein: exam mein aksar students pehla point dekh kar ruk jate hain aur doosra point likhna bhool jate hain. Line aur parabola ke sawal mein hamesha poochiye: kya koi doosri crossing bhi hai? Quadratic equation ke do roots isi baat ka jawab dete hain.

Algebra se tasdeeq (\(f(x) = g(x)\) rakhein)
\[x^2 + 2x - 8 = 3x + 4\]
\[x^2 - x - 12 = 0\]
\[(x - 4)(x + 3) = 0\]
\[x = 4 \text{ or } x = -3\]
\[f(4) = 16,\quad f(-3) = -5\]
Kyun: saare terms aik taraf le jaane se quadratic equation banti hai. Is ke roots milne ke points ke x-coordinates hain, aur un ko line mein rakhne se y-coordinates milte hain (line ki equation aasaan hai, is liye usi ko istemal kiya).

Tasdeeq
\[g(-3) = 9 - 6 - 8 = -5\]
\[f(-3) = -9 + 4 = -5 \;\checkmark\]
\[g(4) = 16 + 8 - 8 = 16\]
\[f(4) = 12 + 4 = 16 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: har point dono equations ko poora kare tabhi woh dono graphs par hai. Dono points ne dono equations poori kar di hain.
blocks.final_answer: Dono graphs \((-3, -5)\) aur \((4, 16)\) par milte hain.

answer_figure.caption: Question 2 (vi): the line, the parabola and their meeting points (original drawing)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke answer key (safha 294-295) mein is sawal ke aath graphs, (i) se (viii) tak, diye gaye hain, jabke sawal mein sirf chhe hisse chhape hain. Graphs (i) se (vi) chhape hue hisson se milte hain; graphs (vii) aur (viii) (line aur parabola) kisi chhape hue hisse ke nahin, un ko nazar andaz kar dein.
